title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
title_zh: AgentRoboCritic：解析前沿智能体直接控制机器人的能力
abstract_en: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.
abstract_zh: GPT-6 Astra 等前沿多模态语言智能体无需调用高层动作原语，即可通过低层数值动作直接控制机器人。然而，现有基准通常只报告整轮任务的成功率，无法解释智能体如何成功、又在哪一步失败。本文在 12 个机器人操作基准上开展动作级分析，并提出以意图为依据的评估框架 AgentRoboCritic：策略智能体在输出每个动作时同时声明局部意图，评估器据此判断动作结果是否符合预期，并识别失败类型。分析表明，前沿智能体能够闭环纠正部分局部执行失误，在多样场景中可靠地将语言语义对应到场景中的实体，并在无需任务特定适配的情况下展现较强的零样本操作能力。不过，抓取和对齐等物理执行环节仍是瓶颈，且不同失败类型的恢复能力差异明显。作者在包含 400 个人工标注动作的基准上验证了评估器，并公开了包含 12,844 个标注动作的数据集和经微调的开源评估器 Muse-Glimmer-30B；其失败类型识别准确率从 32.58% 提升至 74.24%，可用于低成本的动作级分析。
key_points_zh: 在 12 个机器人操作基准上开展动作级分析，弥补整轮任务成功率无法定位具体失误的不足。
AgentRoboCritic 将每个低层动作与智能体声明的局部意图配对，由评估器判断动作是否达成意图，并识别失败类型。
前沿智能体展现出跨场景语义落地、零样本操作和局部闭环纠错能力，但抓取与对齐仍是瓶颈，且不同失败类型的恢复能力不均衡。
研究以 400 个人工标注动作验证评估器，并公开 12,844 个标注动作及开源评估器 Muse-Glimmer-30B；微调后，失败类型识别准确率由 32.58% 提升至 74.24%。

agent-multimodal.reason: 将工具调用中的局部意图与动作前后及短时后续视频帧对齐，用于闭环操作诊断；人工标注和意图消融验证了该框架，并指出何时需补采抬升帧。
